finding: The tested storage-v16 CPU DT omits heterogeneous capacity and cpu-map metadata, so all CPUs retain the default1024 capacity. This agrees with the parent live sysfs observation.

kernel_evidence.meaning: CPU references in cpu-map trigger topology_parse_cpu_capacity.
capacity-dmips-mhz supplies raw CPU capacity; core compatible alone is not a capacity table.
Without CPU clock providers, capacity normalization assumes equal frequency; matches fixed1014MHz baseline.
MC/CLUSTER add optional scheduling domain levels; PKG domain exists without them and asymmetric capacity detection is not gated on these two options.

validation: DTC passed; original memreserve, all non-CPU nodes/properties and old CPU properties match the fixed baseline exactly. All8 new phandle references and capacities verified. Decompilation/recompilation emits numeric-phandle source-marker warnings; full log retained; this is not a warning-free DTS-source build.
experiment_order: First use unchanged kernel with the DT-only candidate; verify online0-7, capacities430x6/1024x2 and cluster topology, then unpinned identical GSK probe and Settings timing.
Keep original DTB as rollback. Do not combine this trial with v18 storage/DMA changes.
Only after DT comparison, evaluate optional MC/CLUSTER config separately if warranted.
